title: Primed slams, instant craters, rebuild by left click, slide trench
desc: Slams you prime by holding shift in flight or crouch on a super-jump fall: the crater opens instantly, stays lined with construct for 3 s and can be rebuilt by left-clicking; without priming you slide and dig a trench.

takes.name: Primed flight slam (shift)
takes.facts: locked at tick 18, lands tick 30, 7x7 crater opens at once, lining 3 s, rebuild ripple from your look at tick 70

takes.name: Primed super-jump slam (crouch)
takes.facts: super jump to 24 blocks, locked head-down tick 40, lands tick 56, 9x9 instant crater, rebuild follows the crosshair sweep; rev 2: the rebuild ripples out from where you look, like P1

takes.name: Unprimed slide
takes.facts: lands tick 30, slides 5 blocks on one knee, trench 3 wide x 6 long, lining one block out all round for 2 s
